nodes.description: Mapping of token balances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and debited unchecked in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented with unchecked ++ in transferFrom.
Mapping of whitelisted addresses that bypass the sale condition in ensure.
Minimum sale amount, set by init and read by condition.
Maximum sale amount, set by init and read by condition.
Sale count limit, set by init and read by condition.
Address whitelisted in ensure; set by setTradeAddress.
Privileged address set in constructor; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Total token supply assigned in constructor.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used in init and constructor scaling.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom.
Internal whitelist gate using pairFor, owner, tradeAddress, canSale and condition.
Public payable transfer entry point; debits allowance/balance without SafeMath and calls ensure.
Public payable allowance setter; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit validation reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution performing unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and infinite allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance ownership and transfer source.
Arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Unchecked subtraction/increment of allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
Unchecked computation of total = _value * _tos.length and resulting balance credits.
_from address parameter of transferFrom.
_to address parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
_spender parameter of approve.
_value parameter of approve.
Target address parameter 'a' of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter 'b' of delegate.
saleNum parameter of init.
token parameter of init.
maxToken parameter of init.
_tos recipient array parameter of batchSend.
_value per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress.
_to parameter of transfer.
_value parameter of transfer.
Local total computed in batchSend and compared against balanceOf.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines whether allowance is debited and which balance is spent in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
msg.sender must equal owner before the arbitrary delegatecall is executed.
msg.sender must equal owner to re-initialize sale parameters.
msg.sender must equal owner to distribute balances in batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
Constructor stores msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder.
_from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked subtraction and addition in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_value parameter is stored into the allowance mapping.
address 'a' is the delegatecall target supplied to delegate.
bytes 'b' is the calldata forwarded by delegate.
Attacker-influenced address becomes the delegatecall target, allowing arbitrary code execution in contract context.
Attacker-influenced calldata is forwarded straight into the delegatecall.
delegate performs an external delegatecall that can re-enter the contract and mutate its storage.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes the ensure whitelist gate.
ensure calls condition to validate sale limits.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure reads canSale to bypass the condition check.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is executed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] with an unchecked ++.
transferFrom is the site of the unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
The unchecked arithmetic mutates the allowance mapping.
The unchecked arithmetic mutates balances.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend debits and credits balanceOf inside an unchecked loop.
batchSend computes total with unchecked multiplication.
Local total is produced by the unchecked _value * _tos.length expression.
Local total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] before debiting.
Local total derives from the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
The unchecked multiplication result flows into balance credits.
_value is a factor in the unchecked multiplication.
_value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
_tos array controls the batchSend loop length.
saleNum parameter is stored as _saleNum.
token parameter determines _minSale scaling.
maxToken parameter determines _maxSale scaling.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
addr parameter is the new tradeAddress value.
condition reads _minSale as a lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale as an upper bound.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address limit.
Constructor sets owner.
Constructor sets totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the owner balance.
Constructor grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter has no independent security meaning outside the transferFrom entry point.
The _to parameter only matters as the transfer destination inside transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked subtraction/addition performed by transferFrom.
The _spender parameter is only meaningful as the allowance key written by approve.
The _value parameter is only meaningful as the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter 'a' is the target address of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter 'b' is the calldata passed into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
saleNum is only consumed by init to configure _saleNum.
token is only consumed by init to configure _minSale.
maxToken is only consumed by init to configure _maxSale.
The _tos array drives the loop of batchSend and nothing else.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
addr is only used as the new tradeAddress value inside setTradeAddress.
_to is only forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
_value is only forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation in batchSend.
